results.title: Cesarean Weekend
results.overview: The mood in the summer villa in northern Iran, near the Caspian Sea, is exuberant. Milad and Armin gather with friends for a weekend shaped by effortless closeness. The news that Bita is pregnant by Milad adds to the fragility of their relationship. The next morning, the hosts’ fathers arrive, each carrying their own fractures

results.title: DOUEN
results.overview: Sania, a first-generation Trinidadian American, is haunted by mischievous Douens and must confront the dark secrets and generational trauma buried within her family before the past claims her future.

results.title: Stranger Things Have Happened to Me
results.original_title: Stranger Things Have Happened to Me
results.overview: Antonio is jealous of his new teammate, Stephon, who has kindled a connection with his girlfriend Mya. His anger fuels the fire that stirs up hidden truths and unravels a long list of lies and deception causing chaos around the college campus.

results.title: The Tuners
results.overview: In the shadows of the world's most important piano competition, a group of expert tuners spend a month vying to achieve the perfect pitch so that the champion pianist will win on their instrument.

results.title: Halifax Pier
results.overview: At the end of a tangled relation- ship, Myra and Percy begin to feel the anxiety of the everyday creep in.

results.title: Loulou
results.overview: Grieving his father, eight-year-old Sam chases a butterfly, saves it from a lake, and tries everything to keep his new companion LouLou alive.

results.title: Watching Mr. Pearson
results.overview: When a once famous actor can no longer decipher the past from the present, two devoted caretakers discover that imagination and performance may be the only way to help him reconnect with the world that's left him behind.

results.title: Perfect Balance
results.overview: Julia is 35 and feels her life is slipping away. Feeling unattractive and taken for granted by both her husband and superiors, she craves to get noticed again. Will ”Echo”, a revolutionary AI-powered scale, be the one to finally see her - and her whole potential?

results.title: Where's Dinner?
results.overview: Horror film about a woman in a toxic relationship. Visual companion for Grace Pehrman's album "SUBURBIA"

results.title: MYXOMATOSIS
results.overview: Harlen’s a young  girl who curiously follows a pair of pink hands through a mirror.  She becomes part of a beautiful world where absolutely everything is controlled by The ominous Man with The Bunnyhead.

results.title: TVF's Headshot
results.overview: Follows the journey of Sachin, a young man caught between his passion for professional gaming and the heavy weight of real-world responsibilities.

results.title: Black Burns Fast
results.overview: Black Burns Fast is a queer and quirky coming of age film set in at a prestigious boarding school in South Africa. 17-year-old adorkable Luthando is on track for a normal academic year, until Ayanda arrives at the school and forces her to rethink everything. In the aftermath, Luthando struggles with juggling multiple identities to avoid rejection from her mother and her schoolmates as she comes to terms with her sexuality.

results.title: Amarte
results.overview: He lives in his own universe. She is a famous soap opera star who needs to disappear from hers. When they meet by accident, what seems like a bad idea becomes a getaway as absurd as it is irresistible. As they flee from the press, between increasingly out of place situations, delirious moments and a connection that no one saw coming, both discover that escaping from reality can be much more fun... and dangerously irresistible for the heart. But when the real world reaches them again, they will have to decide if that encounter was just a perfect fantasy or if it is worth the risk of experiencing something real.

results.title: Mata Hari
results.overview: In 1975, television star David Carradine came up with a novel way to forge a relationship with his estranged daughter Calista: he would make a movie with her. "Mata Hari" tells the story of David and Calista's relationship through the lens of their unfinished, years-long film project, an epic telling of the life of the Dutch courtesan and spy, Mata Hari.

results.title: Aajo Ardhangini
results.overview: Set against the backdrop of an unexpected wedding invitation, a chance reunion after two years of estrangement forces two women to confront their deeply entangled, hidden past. As their unresolved history resurfaces in the shadows of the Chatterjee household, an unsuspecting husband finds himself increasingly caught in a web of unspoken anxieties.

results.title: The Substitute
results.overview: In the midst of Carnival, taxi driver Manoel finds a sex toy in his living room. Huge and still sticky, the object sets off a tragicomic journey that shakes his imagination and challenges his sense of masculinity.

results.title: Golden Earring - One Last Night
results.overview: The grand Golden Earring show in 2026. After more than sixty years, this event marked the final chapter for one of the Netherlands' most successful rock bands.

results.title: Nuclear Boy
results.overview: The lonely 17-year-old outcast Aike craves attention and finds it online where he conducts dangerous chemistry experiments. Hoping to pull Aike out of his internet bubble, his mother, a hardworking nurse, sends him to the scouts to make real friends. When that fails, Aike feels rejected and hurt. To prove himself to the world, he begins his biggest experiment yet: he secretly builds a nuclear breeder reactor in his mother's shed, encouraged by a growing group of internet followers.
